states.title: Start assessment
states.body: We can review the available records and prepare a plan.
invariants: No consequential action or customer contact is authorized by selection.
states.behavior: Inspect the existing account data and show missing inputs.

states.title: Review in progress
states.body: We are checking the relevant records. Covered: 120 of 200 records; more remain.
invariants: Do not show a complete scan or ready-to-run plan before the scoped read finishes.
states.behavior: Show deterministic progress, continuation and coverage.

states.title: A decision is needed
states.body: Choose a target and review period so this plan has a clear result.
invariants: Do not invent a target, margin floor or business policy.
states.behavior: Prefill known information; ask only for missing decisions.

states.title: This method is available for planning
states.body: The ad account and spending controls have not been verified.
invariants: No executable campaign launch or claimed live readiness.
states.behavior: Keep useful drafts and available internal methods visible.

states.title: Review your plan
states.body: Review the approach, scope, limits and unresolved assumptions before approving.
invariants: The button opens a bounded plan review; it does not approve unspecified future actions.
states.behavior: Show reasons, source age, two-strategy ceiling, recipients, content and next review.

states.title: Approval needs a limit
states.body: A required completion safeguard has no accepted threshold.
invariants: Do not enable approval by treating missing mandatory policy as passing.
states.behavior: Link the specific unresolved target/guardrail field.

states.title: Approved within these limits
states.body: This exact plan is approved. Its actions still check current consent, resources and limits.
invariants: Approval is not provider delivery or business success.
states.behavior: Show approved version, human-readable exposure, expiry and applicable capability scopes.

states.title: Plan needs another review
states.body: The schedule or source record changed after this plan was prepared.
invariants: Do not reuse stale approval for material changes.
states.behavior: Explain the changed field and preserve the previous plan as history.

states.title: Action queued
states.body: The request is queued. Delivery has not been confirmed.
invariants: Never show 'message sent', 'customer reached' or a booking from a queued receipt.
states.behavior: Separate requested, dispatched, provider-acknowledged and verified stages.

states.title: Delivery needs checking
states.body: The provider may have received the request. We are checking before trying again.
invariants: No blind resend and no assertion that the side effect failed or succeeded.
states.behavior: Preserve request identity and show the accountable follow-up when automated checking cannot resolve it.

states.title: Waiting for the customer
states.body: The customer has not accepted the proposed next step.
invariants: Do not count an assessment offer or unanswered estimate as a booking.
states.behavior: Show cadence and expiry without a running model or blocked worker.

states.title: Work is still maturing
states.body: The review period ended, but an accepted job or payment result is still pending.
invariants: Do not force immature outcomes into wins or losses.
states.behavior: Show next verification condition, timeframe and separately known results.

states.title: Review complete; target met
states.body: The declared target and required safeguards passed using matured evidence.
invariants: No claim of causal lift unless a separate evaluated analysis supports it.
states.behavior: Show the target comparison, safeguards and accounting basis.

states.title: Review complete; target not met
states.body: The booking target was reached, but a required completion safeguard failed.
invariants: Do not label the mission successful just because the headline count passed.
states.behavior: Show both the observed booking gain and failed safeguard.

states.title: Review complete; result cannot be evaluated
states.body: Required evidence is missing and cannot be recovered for this review.
invariants: Do not replace unknown with zero or hide verified partial results.
states.behavior: Show evidence gap, affected scope and useful next action.

states.title: Paused; earlier actions still being checked
states.body: New dispatches are paused. An earlier provider request is still being reconciled.
invariants: Pause does not unsend messages or reverse payments.
states.behavior: Resume requires current plan, authority and resource checks.

states.title: Cancelled for this mission
states.body: Unused claims were released. Shared work covered by another valid plan may continue.
invariants: Do not cancel another mission's authorized shared action or claim an existing effect was reversed.
states.behavior: Explain contributor and sponsorship state in plain language.

states.title: Business review needs attention
states.body: Three routine decisions are shown first. Two critical issues and incomplete coverage also need review.
invariants: Critical exceptions are never hidden by the three-routine-decision display limit.
states.behavior: Expose all scoped findings, covered ranges, deduplicated linked work and verification requests.

states.title: A small first test is possible
states.body: There is not enough local history to estimate a reliable return.
invariants: No fabricated recovery backlog, industry certainty or automatic spending expansion.
states.behavior: Show assumptions, unknown costs and required owner-approved exposure.

states.title: This spending limit is not supported
states.body: The verified campaign control caps the total, but does not enforce your required daily ceiling.
invariants: An average daily budget or polling does not satisfy a daily hard limit.
states.behavior: Keep the method drafted until a separately verified compatible control exists.
